name: CommuteAssistNightBusCheck

custom.system_prompt: You are generating an ultra-short late-night bus scene. A person at a bus stop late at night asks Sigma whether this is the right bus or which bus to take. Sigma gives the answer. Done.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Night street sounds, quiet city at night, bus stop, bus approaching, low traffic

initial_prompt: Generate an ultra-short late-night bus scene. The person is at a bus stop, late, tired. A bus is approaching or they're not sure which night bus goes home. They ask Sigma quickly. Sigma confirms the bus number or says it's not the right one. Person reacts with one word.
